messages:
olivia: heads up — deploybot could not finish canary promote, it auto-set manual-hold. anyone saw the error?

deploy-bot: promote failed step=push-release-artifact reason=shard-lock-conflict code=409 shard=us-west-2-a/22 owner=pruner-4a2c
```
Error: shard lock conflict while finalizing artifact
  at /app/pruner/handler.go:289
  code=409; lock_owner=pruner-4a2c; op=finalize
```

ci-bot: build health: 4 failing integration runs in the last 8h on branch release/2026-03. Common failure: tests/integration/session_gc::TestSessionGC flakiness. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/3789/logs

sam: could be pruning collided with image push. quick unblock: pin to last-known-good digest and manual promote.

ana: (typo) ana: caution: the commit also contains migration 20260314-add-session-index. reverting might be heavy. prefer pin + observe.

leigh: i can perform manual promote if infra unblocks the lock. can we get a smoke run after?

harry: i'd prefer to hold the full cut until 20:00 PT window so SRE can monitor and roll back if needed. otherwise pin+promote now and delay full rollout to that window.

sam: poll: options = [pin & promote now + delay cut, rollback commit, wait for pruner fix then auto-promote]. votes? :ballot_box_with_check:

olivia: strong preference for pin & manual promote + follow-up fix for pruner TTL. avoids reverting migration. who will update release notes and include rollback steps?

devops: pruner oncall alerted, found a stuck pruning job holding shard for ~9m. i've cancelled job pruner-4a2c and cleared the lock. will open ticket to investigate why it didn't release.

deploy-bot: automatic retries attempted 3 times, now paused. suggested dry-run promote below:
```
# dry-run
deployctl promote --cluster=prod-us-west --repo=release/2026-03 --image=sha256:fedcba9876543210 --canary --dry-run
```

leigh: doing manual promote now (pin to sha256:fedcba9876543210). will run auth + healthcheck smoke.

leigh: smoke results: auth ok, read/write basic ops ok, latency within expected. promoting canary to 3 replicas.

deploy-bot: manual promote finished: canary=3 replicas in prod-us-west.

olivia: thanks. harry please keep change-window at 20:00 PT and be ready to roll back. leigh pls add rollback instructions to release notes and open follow-up for pruner concurrency.

harry: will monitor during the window and be on-call at 20:00 PT.

leigh: release notes entry added with rationale and links. rollback snippet included:
```
# rollback to previous image digest
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=registry.internal/release@sha256:012345abcdef --record
```

olivia: good. opened follow-up: INFRA-2026 investigate pruner lock TTL + coordinate prune windows with pushes. marking this thread resolved for the immediate unblock. will reconvene post-window to decide full rollout. :white_check_mark:
